files.description: Latest macro/rates snapshot for the dashboard header and regime panel.
Daily 2Y/5Y/10Y/30Y Treasury yields and curve slopes, 2015-present.
Monthly inflation, real-yield, breakeven and regime-label panel.
Synthetic Treasury universe with price, duration, convexity, DV01 and key-rate durations.
Controlled starting portfolios for the exposure builder.
Deterministic curve-shock scenarios with real/breakeven decomposition.
Scenario P&L, approximation comparison and attribution for every preset.
Per-instrument scenario returns enabling controlled custom weights in the UI.
Pre/post hedge metrics, effectiveness and residual loss for every combination.
Calibrated Vasicek and CIR parameters with Feller condition.
Summarized simulated short-rate paths and terminal distributions.
Rates-specific VaR and Expected Shortfall by portfolio and model.

source_summary: Public real yield and breakeven inflation data (FRED)
Public CPI / core CPI index data (FRED)
Synthetic Treasury instruments built from the real curve snapshot
limitations: The site uses static offline-generated data; nothing is computed live.
Synthetic Treasury instruments are representative proxies, not CUSIP-level securities.
Scenario shocks are analytical stress tests, not forecasts.
TIPS-style exposure is a simplified real-yield proxy without index-ratio cash flows.
Vasicek and CIR are stylized short-rate models, not full term-structure models.
VaR is model-dependent and is not a guaranteed loss threshold.
Hedge overlays reduce selected exposures; they do not eliminate risk.
